initial_page_verifier_failure.observed_error: AssertionError in removal of re/W/n operators before canonical-content equality
initial_page_verifier_failure.cause: The first verifier removed existing re/W/n clips as well as added triples; candidate output construction was unchanged.
initial_page_verifier_failure.correction: Compare original content bytes after undoing only the declared rectangle-plus-matrix tokens.

failures: Initial cohort preflight exposed three BilevelOverlay draws outside the prior helper regex, plus image-free pages. The new original helper admits these explicitly while retaining their exact operators and copies entirely image-free PDFs unchanged.

The first preparation wrapper passed a string to an existing Path-based semantic verifier after preparing one PDF. Retained the file/log and initial wrapper, corrected only the argument type, and regenerated in a separate directory; the first output bytes are identical.

One candidate session reached a terminal zero-visit numeric-layout failure. Retained it and used the previously established one-page bootstrap route; all six replacement visits pass unchanged admission.

An initial page-coordinate verifier also removed existing text clipping triples. Replaced it with exact-byte undo of only declared inserted rectangle tokens. The first candidate remains byte-identical and no Wine observation preceded correction.
Eight100% visits exceed the fixed complete-page viewport and remain rejected; identical file bytes are observed at95% instead. No100% counterexample comparison is claimed.

Source information bars cause four additional75/95% visits to fail whole-viewport admission despite independent complete paper crops. Existing close-bar retry driver admits four replacement visits without changing numeric/frame gates.

Reference review found seven historical source sessions with incomplete whole-viewport flags despite complete independent paper crops. All13native sources/77pages were freshly observed under both gates. Every new crop equals its historical crop; final primary analyses use the new source labels. Preliminary analysis logs are retained; no ineligible reference contributes a final score.

The first receipt privacy gate caught absolute paths nested inside rejected audit rows and stopped before writing a public receipt. Applied the same path-field sanitization recursively to analyses; observations, hashes, rejection reasons and counts remain retained.
limitations: Unconditional clipping regresses an actual page at75%, even though it improves the same page at95%. Geometry-equivalent page-coordinate clipping reproduces all eight tested unit-coordinate views; it does not rescue the model.
The alternate coordinate construction covers only the six changed cohort pages at75% and the two changed counterexample pages at95%, not an independent full-cohort alternate-path sweep.
No production correction, runtime-parity rerun, dependency/API/I/O change, merge or release is claimed. #543/#541/#406 remain open; every production cohort page still differs.
